display_long_description:
Pop The Loons is a slingshot game for Meta Quest. Raise one hand and close it to hold the slingshot, pinch the pouch with the other, pull back and let go. Or pick up your Touch controllers and squeeze. The aim arc shows where each shot lands.

Prefer one hand? Turn on One hand: look at a loon, pinch your thumb to your index or middle finger, and let go to throw. Pop School teaches the slingshot, then one hand, and lets you pick.

Three worlds:
- A candy garden floating in the sky.
- Balloon city: ride a hot-air balloon over a toy city.
- Your own room in mixed reality: balloons rise off your furniture and critters break out of your walls.

LOONY LOONS
- Seven levels, each with new loons.
- Bomb Loons set off chain pops, Tin Loons wear helmets, Mama Loons split into babies, and Prize Loons carry gifts: Spike Balls, Ricochets, Seekers and the Twin Sling.
- Critters fight back with zaps, lasers, snowballs and fireballs. Pop them before they fire and keep your five hearts.
- Every level ends with its own boss. Watch it wind up its shot and lean out of the way.
- Daily Loons: one run a day for a streak and bonus coins.
- Calm mode: endless, relaxed popping with nothing attacking.
- Spend coins in the Coin Shop on sling bands, ball trails and balloon colours.

Play seated or standing; nothing comes within a metre of your head. Left-handed? Turn it on in Settings.

Early Access: more is on the way, tuned by your feedback. Tell us what you think from the support page.
